summary: Temporary restricted query access to raw inference traces for security investigation
description:
Issue summary: Security team requests time-limited, read-only access to raw inference traces (logs + input/output tokens) in prod to investigate a suspected information disclosure reported by a customer incident.

Impact: Investigation required to determine scope of potential data exposure. Access must be tightly scoped to a small set of traces, instrumented with full audit logs, and approved by Legal and Privacy before any retrieval. Incorrect handling could cause non-compliance with our data handling policies or contractual obligations for enterprise customers.

Request details: Provide a temporary IAM role or short-lived signed URL that allows Security engineers to run restricted queries against the logging store for trace IDs matching: trace_id in ["tr-20260312-8f4c3","tr-20260313-a1b2c"] and customer_id = "cust-9482". Time window: 2026-03-11T00:00:00Z through 2026-03-13T23:59:59Z. Output must be redacted for any full PII tokens and must not be exported outside the approved investigation VM.

Compliance constraints: Must retain an immutable audit trail (who, when, query), record the exact datasets accessed, and store any extracts only in a pre-approved secure bucket with 30-day retention. Legal and Privacy sign-off required before access is granted.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Security has read-only access scoped to the specific trace IDs and time window; 2) Audit logging enabled and verified; 3) Legal/Privacy sign-off attached to this ticket; 4) Access automatically expires after 72 hours or on manual revocation, whichever is first.
access_request_steps: 1) Security attaches signed request and justification. 2) Ops prepares ephemeral IAM role + scoped query lambda. 3) Security and Ops run scoped queries in investigation VM only. 4) Audit logs verified by Privacy. 5) Role revoked after confirmation or automatically at TTL.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-13 09:12 - Triage: Reporter flagged potential disclosure after receiving customer's redacted example. Security requested raw traces to validate.
2026-03-13 11:01 - Ops: Confirmed traces exist for requested trace_ids; storage is in encrypted S3 with existing access controls. Prepared template for short-lived role.
2026-03-14 08:45 - Privacy: Initial review indicates this is within scope for forensic review but requires Legal sign-off due to enterprise contract clause on log exports.
comments: Maya Patel (Reporter) 2026-03-13: Customer reported that model returned a string resembling a hashed token — they suspect internal identifier leakage. Requesting Security to validate.

Liam O'Connor (Assignee) 2026-03-13: Received. Will coordinate with Ops to produce a scoped role; will not export raw payloads until Legal approves. Preparing pre-approved secure bucket for any extracts.
Priya Singh (Legal) 2026-03-14: Need explicit customer waiver or confirmation that logs for cust-9482 can be reviewed. If this affects PII, add Data Protection Officer (DPO) as reviewer.
Eugene Park (Privacy) 2026-03-14: Asked Security to limit query to entry/exit token windows and to perform redaction of email-like patterns before any human review.
next_steps: 1) Security to submit formal evidence request form and attach customer's consent or justification. 2) Legal to respond with approval or conditions. 3) Ops to deploy ephemeral role and scoped lambda; verify audit hooks. 4) Grant access for up to 72 hours once approval recorded here.
resolution: Pending approvals from Legal and Privacy. No data exported yet. Ops has prepared a read-only role template and a secure, TTL-limited S3 bucket for any approved extracts.
